title: Herbal Knead & Date
description: A ghee-based herbal dish infused with juicy dates for a delightful date-night treat that's sugar-free-friendly.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup chopped fresh herbs (e.g., mint, cilantro)
2 medium dates, pitted and roughly chopped
1/4 cup granulated sugar (optional for sweetening if desired)
ingredients.notes: For a sugar-free version, omit this ingredient

instructions: In a small saucepan, heat the ghee over medium-low heat until melted.
Add the chopped herbs and roughly chopped dates to the melted ghee. Stir well to combine.
Pour the mixture into an oven-safe dish.
Bake for 20-30 minutes or until the edges are golden brown and the center is slightly soft when pressed.
Let it cool slightly before serving.
